page.layout: One page of text, verse in stanzas. Top: a continued stanza of italic verse under the running head. Below a rule, a small title centred, then four stanzas of roman verse, the first with a large initial F. Catchword "Clade:" at the lower right. Page number at the head left. No margin notes.

p.i: Genus rupta Syoniæ. Nonfas follicitus parcere quastubus. Languentes dolor excitet Nocturnus lachrymas, & gemitus truces Exorium tubar augeat. Ne luctu abstineant perpete pupulæ.

main_text.head: COPH. RESCH. SCHIN.
main_text.p: FVRVA quum redeuntibus Nox fugat tenebris diem: Quum vigil tacitas agit Primus excubias, Syon, Surge territa lecto.
Tunde vocibus arduum Ætherem querulis, opem Posce, tendito supplices Ad Patrem Superum manus, Cordáque vuida fletu.
Nec modum precibus tuis Pone. Namque per vrbium Cuncta compita nunc iacet Turba parvula, quam fames Tabe conficit atra.
Rex poli Deus aspice Qua genus perit Abrami

page.notes: Top stanza is a continuation from the previous page; "tubar" and "quastubus" are doubtful readings and may be [?]-worthy. "vuida" is as printed. Faint show-through from the reverse page in the right margin and a small mark at the top left were ignored. The stanza breaks are taken from the visible line spacing.
